summary: v56u frontend-only test. All 3 features PASS. (1) /tenders/all: the tenders-country-filter is a <select> with 251 options ('All countries' + 250 countries) and no duplicates. Selecting IN gives 11 entries, all IN, URL ?country=IN. KZ gives 47; 11+47 = 58 total. Choosing 'All countries' brings back 58 and drops the param from the URL. The deep link ?country=in (lowercase) preselects IN. The tenders-contract-filter has 31 options, no duplicate values or labels, grouped under EPC Contracts / PPP / Services / Supply / Works; Framework and O&M show as plain options because they have no children. (2) Homepage hero, no duplicates in any control: home-hero-country 251 options, home-hero-sector 26, home-hero-contract 31 (same grouping), home-hero-category 106. (3) Admin Masters > Contract types: the 'Remove duplicates' button (taxonomy-dedupe-btn) sits next to '+ New contract type'. Clicking it opens the confirm dialog; accepting calls POST /api/v1/masters/dedupe-taxonomy (200) and shows the toast 'No duplicates found — all clean.' The button is also on the Sectors tab.

design_issues.screen: Admin > Masters > Contract types / Sectors table (TaxonomyTab Row, child rows)
issues: Child row names (e.g. '↳ Construction & Execution', '↳ Annuity', '↳ Solar') are nearly invisible: very pale grey on the light row background. The class is text-slate-700, which the admin theme appears to override or wash out. Use text-brand-navy/80 or similar. Not part of v56u; seen in screenshots.

action_items: (Low) Fix the contrast of child-row names in the TaxonomyTab table.
critical_code_review_comments: uniqByCode keeps the first row per code. If production duplicates have different is_active or name values, which row the UI shows depends on API order. That is acceptable, but the backend dedupe should keep the same 'earliest' row so the two agree.
The board's Category filter is still a free-text input, while Sector, Contract type and Country are now dropdowns. Not in scope, noted for consistency.
